option_relations.rationale: Developmental delay is a common manifestation of Capillary malformation-arteriovenous malformation (CM-AVM) syndrome.
RASA1-related disorders (Capillary Malformation-Arteriovenous Malformation Syndrome) is the full name for Capillary malformation-arteriovenous malformation (CM-AVM) syndrome (RASA1-related).
Vascular malformation of the nose, specifically epistaxis and findings on nasal endoscopy, is a manifestation of Capillary malformation-arteriovenous malformation (CM-AVM) syndrome.
Concurrent Microcephaly-capillary malformation syndrome (MIC-CAP) and Mowat-Wilson syndrome (MWS) are distinct genetic syndromes not directly related to the provided leaf.
